svg.title: How GRI Design Bench works
svg.desc: A fixed formulation senses tissue glucose and changes insulin release, subject to leakage, delay and a finite reservoir. The agent iterates over candidate parameters using training simulations, then submits one fixed design. Independent evaluation uses 18 three-day trajectories on new meal scenarios. Every trajectory must satisfy the safety thresholds for the design to receive its mean time in range; any failure scores zero. Models rank by feasible attempts first and mean score second.
